subject: Catalyst Alloy — SDK integration & tracing pilot
messages:
From: Samantha Cole <samantha@catalystalloy.io>
To: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>
Cc: Evan Brooks <evan@alloy.consulting>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Catalyst Alloy x Redwood — SDK integration (tracing + telemetry)

Hi Logan,

Thanks again for the call this morning. Catalyst Alloy is excited about the idea of embedding Redwood as the default inference engine in our AlloyStudio orchestration product. High-level asks from our side:

- Tight trace integration (we need per-inference spans + token-level timing) so customers can map user prompts to cost/latency.
- An SDK shim for LangChain and LlamaIndex usage patterns we already ship.
- A small pilot (2–4 customers) that runs on Redwood Hosted, then a Dedicated option for later.

I've attached a short doc with our requirements and a sample customer persona. Can you confirm whether Redwood's trace hooks will surface the level of granularity we need? Also, what does your typical timeline look like for a partner pilot?

Thanks — happy to jump on a short working session next week.

Best,
Samantha Cole
Director of Integrations
Catalyst Alloy

Attachment: catalyst-integration-requirements.pdf
From: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Cole <samantha@catalystalloy.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Catalyst Alloy x Redwood — SDK integration (tracing + telemetry)

Samantha — thanks for the detailed note and the doc. This is exactly the kind of partner pilot we prioritize. Quick responses inline: 

- Trace granularity: yes — our tracing pipeline can emit span-per-request and optional token-level timing. We currently surface those as structured attributes in our trace events (span name, model_variant, prompt_id, latency_ms, token_timings array). For the pilot we can enable token-level timings behind a flag to limit the payload size.

- SDK shim: we have an adapter pattern in our SDKs for LangChain/LlamaIndex. Marissa (cc'd) leads SDK partner work — she can outline the adapter contract and a minimal integration checklist.

- Timeline: typical pilot is 4–6 weeks: week 0 kickoff + requirements, weeks 1–3 engineering work (adapter + trace hooks), week 4 pilot with 1–2 customers, week 5 wrap and SOW for Dedicated. We can compress to 3–4 weeks if Alloy provides a sandbox repo and a single pilot customer.

Action items:
- Marissa: can you produce the adapter spec and a short checklist by EOD Wed?
- Samantha / Evan: share a sandbox repo or sample prompt workloads and let us know compliance constraints (PCI/PHI etc).
- I'll open a HubSpot deal + shared drive for artifacts (HubSpot link below).

Relevant links: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/67890
Docs: https://docs.redwood.ai/tracing

Happy to set a 30-min working session Thu if that helps.

Cheers,
Logan Wright
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference

Samantha / Logan — quick technical follow-up and proposed minimal adapter contract. TL;DR: doable with low lift if Alloy can accept an HTTP/webhook-style trace sink and add a small wrapper in AlloyStudio where calls go through the Redwood adapter.

Minimal adapter scope (what we'll deliver):
- LangChain connector wrapper: implements call(), stream(), and token-level callback.
- LlamaIndex plugin: indexer-side embedding + query wrapper to preserve context IDs.
- Tracing hook: a lightweight client that emits span metadata to Redwood's trace API and mirrors a copy to Alloy's telemetry endpoint if requested.

Privacy/compliance notes: if Alloy requires token-level export to their telemetry, we recommend the following controls: token hashing, sampled token-timing only for flagged sessions, and enterprise-only opt-in.

Proposed pilot schedule (condensed):
- Week 0 (kickoff): define pilot customer and compliance boundary.
- Week 1: adapter PoC (LangChain sample + trace toggles).
- Week 2: sandbox run with 1 pilot customer.
- Week 3: outcome review and SOW finalization.

Attachments: redwood-trace-spec.md (stubbed) 

Samantha — could you also confirm whether your pilot customers need IP addrs whitelisted or a VPC peering/Dedicated option? That will affect whether we start hosted or request dedicated access.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Sr. Product Manager, SDKs & Integrations
Redwood Inference
